excerpt_i18n.en:
On October 24, Tencent released the "2025 Tencent R&D Big Data Report," systematically disclosing its 2025 R&D progress for the first time. The report shows that AI has been fully integrated into Tencent's R&D system, becoming a new engine driving efficiency improvements. Over 90% of Tencent engineers use the AI programming assistant CodeBuddy, and 50% of new code is AI-assisted. By leveraging WeDev to streamline the R&D toolchain and connect processes, overall R&D efficiency has increased by over 20%.

In 2025, R&D personnel made up 76% of Tencent's workforce, with three out of every four employees engaged in R&D. Tencent added an average of 325 million lines of new code monthly, completed 370,000 requirements per month, and executed 25.2 million builds and deliveries, supporting rapid business iteration.

With the support of its self-developed Hunyuan large model, AI has deeply penetrated coding, review, testing, and other stages. 50% of new code is AI-assisted, meaning for every two lines of new code written by engineers, one is completed with AI help. AI assistance has reduced average coding time by 40% and boosted overall R&D efficiency by over 20%.

In code reviews, AI participation reaches 94%, indicating nearly every code submission at Tencent is pre-reviewed by an AI quality inspector before human engineers intervene, with AI identifying 28% of code defects.

El informe muestra que la IA se ha integrado completamente en el sistema de I+D de Tencent, convirtiéndose en un "nuevo motor" que impulsa la eficiencia en el desarrollo. Más del 90% de los ingenieros de Tencent utilizan el asistente de programación con IA CodeBuddy para apoyar su trabajo, y el 50% del código nuevo se genera con asistencia de IA. Gracias a WeDev, se ha integrado la cadena de herramientas de eficiencia en I+D, conectando los procesos de desarrollo y logrando una mejora superior al 20% en la eficiencia general de I+D de la empresa. El 50% del código nuevo de Tencent se genera con asistencia de IA. En 2025, el personal de I+D y producción de Tencent representa el 76% de la plantilla, es decir, 3 de cada 4 empleados de Tencent.

Leifeng News: On October 23, 2025, Tencent's IMA Open Day was held in Beijing, where IMA announced the IMA 2.0 version, set to begin internal testing on the 24th. The IMA 2.0 version includes features such as the "Task Mode" based on agent capabilities and the knowledge base "AI Key Points." The upgraded IMA will become a "collaborative partner" capable of understanding goals, executing tasks, and producing results.

Through intelligent agents enabling autonomous planning, the "Task Mode" supports generating reports and podcasts. Users can initiate tasks by asking questions in natural language on the homepage or within the knowledge base and can attach resources like knowledge bases, documents, images, audio, web pages, and notes, providing the large model with a "reference textbook" for task execution. When generating podcasts in audio format, it allows selecting the number of participants and voice tones to meet deep information processing and creative needs in learning or work scenarios.

After activating "Task Mode," IMA autonomously breaks down and plans task steps using LLM based on web-wide or knowledge base data, utilizing tools such as in-depth content reading, web-wide searches, knowledge base queries, and content creation to fulfill user instructions. It self-monitors and corrects during execution, ultimately delivering directly usable results. For example, inputs like "help me write a report on the new energy vehicle market," "summarize key points from a meeting discussion and generate minutes," or "design a lesson on 'life'" are supported.

La IMA actualizada se convertirá en un "compañero de trabajo" capaz de comprender objetivos, ejecutar tareas y producir resultados. A través de agentes inteligentes que permiten una planificación autónoma, el "Modo Tarea" genera informes y podcasts. Los usuarios pueden acceder a esta función desde la página de inicio o dentro de la base de conocimientos.

items.raw_excerpt: AI 能不能真正“动脑子”？这个问题有了新答案。 蚂蚁开源团队推出的 Ring-1T 模型，为这个长期存在的疑问提供了最具说服力的实证。不同于以往依赖海量数据“记忆”答案的语言模型，Ring-1T 试图让 AI 在复杂问题中真正“推理”出答案。 它通过强化学习与多阶段推理机制的结合，使模型能够在反馈中不断修正思路、优化逻辑路径，逐步形成更稳定、更接近人类思维的推理模式。 正是这种从“模仿”到“思考”的转变，让 Ring-1T 成为开源 AI 领域的一次里程碑式突破。接下来，让我们看看这项研究是如何实现的。 论文地址：https://arxiv.org/pdf/2510.18855 通用智能的火花 实验中 Ring-1T 模型在多个高难度推理与数学基准上进行了系统性评估，都取得了突破性的实验成果。作为一个开源的万亿参数思考型模型，Ring-1T 分别在推理、数学、编程及通用智能任务上均展现出卓越的综合能力。 在数学推理能力方面，Ring-1T 在 AIME-2025中取得 93.4 分的成绩，接近人类顶尖选手水平；在 HMMT-2025 中得分 86.72，显示其在跨领域数学推理与高复杂度逻辑演算中的强大能力；在 IMO-2025 模拟评测中达到银牌水平，证明模型能够在需要多步推理与创造性证明的问题中保持高准确率和稳定性。 在编程与算法能力上，模型在 Codeforces 平台测试中获得 2088 分，达到人类程序员的高水平区间。这表明 Ring-1T 不仅能够理解算法逻辑，还能在有限时间内生成高效、可执行的代码，具备良好的算法复杂度控制与问题分解能力。 在通用智能推理任务中，Ring-1T 在 ARC-AGI-v1 中取得 55.94 分，显著超越此前开源模型的平均表现。该结果表明，模型在抽象模式识别、思维迁移与多步认知推理方面具备接近通用人工智能的潜力。 总体而言，Rin

excerpt_i18n.en:
Can AI truly "think"? This question has a new answer. The Ring-1T model, released by Ant Group's open-source team, provides the most compelling evidence yet for this long-standing query. Unlike previous language models that rely on vast data to "memorize" answers, Ring-1T aims to enable AI to genuinely "reason" out solutions to complex problems. By combining reinforcement learning with a multi-stage reasoning mechanism, the model continuously refines its thought process and optimizes logical pathways through feedback, gradually forming a more stable reasoning pattern closer to human cognition. This shift from "imitation" to "thinking" marks a milestone breakthrough in the open-source AI field. Now, let's explore how this research was achieved. Paper link: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2510.18855.

In experiments, the Ring-1T model underwent systematic evaluation on multiple high-difficulty reasoning and math benchmarks, achieving groundbreaking results. As an open-source trillion-parameter thinking model, Ring-1T demonstrated outstanding comprehensive abilities in reasoning, mathematics, programming, and general intelligence tasks. In mathematical reasoning, Ring-1T scored 93.4 in AIME-2025, nearing top human performance, and achieved 86.72 in HMMT-2025, showcasing its capabilities in cross-domain mathematical reasoning and high complexity.
excerpt_i18n.es: ¿Puede la IA realmente "pensar"? Esta pregunta tiene una nueva respuesta. El modelo Ring-1T, lanzado por el equipo de código abierto de Ant Group, ofrece la evidencia más convincente hasta ahora para esta duda de larga data. A diferencia de los modelos lingüísticos anteriores que dependían de memorizar respuestas con cantidades masivas de datos, Ring-1T intenta que la IA realmente "razone" las respuestas en problemas complejos. Mediante la combinación de aprendizaje por refuerzo y un mecanismo de razonamiento multietapa, permite al modelo corregir continuamente su enfoque y optimizar rutas lógicas basándose en la retroalimentación, formando gradualmente un patrón de razonamiento más estable y cercano al pensamiento humano. Es precisamente esta transición de "imitar" a "pensar" lo que convierte a Ring-1T en un referente de código abierto.
